thread:
maya: Heads-up — starting a canary for model v3.2 today 14:00 UTC. Plan is percent-based+region ramp. Need oncall coverage and one reviewer to own flag toggles. Flag key is ff:feature.model.v3_2.canary. Targets: US 5% -> 25% over 30m, EU start at 2% -> up to 10% after 1h if metrics look good. Will follow the canary runbook and post updates here.

alan: Can you paste the exact flag key + PR? Who owns rollback if we need to kill it quickly?

maya: Flag: `ff:feature.model.v3_2.canary`. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/4823. Owner: rita on rotation (alt: cheng). Rollback plan: set percent to 0 and enable `ff:feature.model.v3_2.fallback` = true.

rita: :thumbsup: I can own monitoring/rollback. Which hard thresholds should I watch?

cheng: Suggest hard kill if 99p latency increases >200ms OR error rate >0.8% sustained for 5m. For quality: hallucination rate +1.5% above baseline over 15m => rollback. Also monitor token cost delta.

maya: Added to runbook snippet: `if latency_99p delta >200ms for 5m OR error_rate >0.8% for 5m OR convo_hallucination_delta >1.5% for 15m -> immediate rollback`

jules: Gate EU ramp behind US being green for at least 1h. Also do not exceed 10% EU in first 24h.

maya: Agreed. Schedule: 14:00 set US->5%, 14:20 -> 15% if green, 14:50 -> 25% if still clean. EU: 15:10 set 2%, reassess at 16:10 and max 10%. I'll post live toggles.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary toggle updated: ff:feature.model.v3_2.canary set to 5% (US) by maya at 1712456789. Audit: https://audit.redwood/log/ff/1712456789

oncall-bot: oncall-bot: Reminder — oncall coverage 14:00-16:00 UTC today: maya / rita. Use /incident create if SLO breached.

alan: Quick nit: ensure region routing policy is `route_by_region=true` so EU traffic doesn't go through US fallback.

maya: Done. Also kicking off cache warmup job: `jobs/warmup_kv --model v3.2 --regions us,eu`

rita: Monitoring dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/d/abc/model-v3.2?orgId=1 and SLOs: https://slo.redwood/overview. I'll add the evaluation prompt-set to the watch panel.

cheng: I'll standby to flip `ff:feature.model.v3_2.fallback`. Ping me before manual rollback; I'll act if we exceed thresholds.

jules: :eyes: I'll watch evals for hallucination/accuracy drift. If we see spike -> call it and we rollback.

maya: Small deploy note so it's in-thread: toggle command (run from ops-admin):
```
curl -X POST https://flags.redwood/api/toggle \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' \ 
  -d '{"key":"ff:feature.model.v3_2.canary","region":"us","percent":5}'
```

rita: Confirming I'll be monitoring latency, errors, and evals for the first 30m after each step. I have alerts wired: latency_99p_delta, request_error_rate, eval_hallucination_delta.

maya: Starting now. US set to 5% (see audit link). Will update when we move to 15%.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary toggle updated: ff:feature.model.v3_2.canary set to 15% (US) by maya at 1712457040. Audit: https://audit.redwood/log/ff/1712457040

jin: (note: jin is not in participants list)

alan: Thanks — tagging ops-runner to ensure we're ready for a fast 0% flip if needed.

maya: Final note: EU ramp blocked until US green 1h. EU plan will start only after rita confirms baseline metrics are stable.

rita: Confirmed at 1712457760 — US metrics stable for 1h. Proceeding to EU 2% at 15:10 UTC.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary toggle updated: ff:feature.model.v3_2.canary set to 2% (EU) by rita at 1712457800. Audit: https://audit.redwood/log/ff/1712457800

maya: Thanks everyone. We'll keep this thread as the single source of truth for toggle timestamps and rollback notes. If anything abnormal, tag @rita or @cheng and create an incident.
